lines.translation: You are the Great Giver; I am Your slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam kripaa kar deejai gur giaan ratan deepaaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: Please be merciful and bless me with Your Ambrosial Naam, and the jewel, the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat mil ihu tan keeaa ||
lines.translation: From the union of the five elements, this body was made.
Finding the Lord, the Supreme Soul, peace is established.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: karam karatoot a(n)mrit phal laagaa har naam ratan man paaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: The good karma of past actions brings fruitful rewards, and man is blessed with the jewel of the Lord's Name. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis bhookh piaas man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: His mind does not feel any hunger or thirst.
He knows the Immaculate Lord to be everywhere, in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ras raataa keval bairaagee guramat bhaai subhaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Ambrosial essence, he becomes a pure, detached renunciate; he is lovingly absorbed in the Guru's Teachings. ||8||
Whoever does the deeds of the soul, day and night,
sees the immaculate Divine Light deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rasaal rasan ras rasanaa ben rasaal vajaaiaa ||9||
lines.translation: Enraptured with the delightful essence of the Shabad, the source of nectar, my tongue plays the sweet music of the flute. ||9||
He alone plays the sweet music of this flute,
who knows the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak boojhahu ih bidh guramat har raam naam liv laaiaa ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, know this, through the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly focus yourself on the Lord's Name. ||10||
Rare are those beings in this world,
who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and remain detached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarahi sa(n)gat kul taarahi tin saphal janam jag aaiaa ||11||
lines.translation: They save themselves, and save all their associates and ancestors; fruitful is their birth and coming into this world. ||11||
He alone knows the home of his own heart, and the door to the temple,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis poore gur te sojhee hoee ||
lines.translation: who obtains perfect understanding from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਮਹਲ ਮਹਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa gaR mahal mahalee prabh saachaa sach saachaa takhat rachaaiaa ||12||
lines.translation: In the body-fortress is the palace; God is the True Master of this Palace. The True Lord established His True Throne there. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਹਾਟ ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chatur das haat deeve dui saakhee ||
lines.translation: The fourteen realms and the two lamps are the witnesses.
The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar vasat anoop niramolak gur miliai har dhan paaiaa ||13||
lines.translation: Deep within, is the priceless, incomparable commodity; meeting with the Guru, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. ||13||
He alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne.
Following the Guru's Teachings, he subdues the five demons, and becomes the Lord's foot soldier.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee sahasaa bharam chukaaiaa ||14||
lines.translation: He has existed from the very beginning of time and throughout the ages; He exists here and now, and will always exist. Meditating on Him, skepticism and doubt are dispelled. ||14||
The Lord of the Throne is greeted and worshipped day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu saach vadaaee guramat liv jaatee ||
lines.translation: This true glorious greatness comes to those who love the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam japahu tar taaree har a(n)t sakhaaee paaiaa ||15||1||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, and swim across the river; they find the Lord, their best friend, in the end. ||15||1||18||
Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan sa(n)chahu re jan bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Gather in the wealth of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
Serve the True Guru, and remain in His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tasakar chor na laagai taa kau dhun upajai sabad jagaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: This wealth cannot be stolen; the celestial melody of the Shabad wells up and keeps us awake and aware. ||1||
You are the One Universal Creator, the Immaculate King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aap savaarahi jan ke kaajaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself arrange and resolve the affairs of Your humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: amar adol apaar amolak har asathir thaan suhaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: You are immortal, immovable, infinite and priceless; O Lord, Your place is beautiful and eternal. ||2||
In the body-village, the most sublime place,
the supremely noble people dwell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: oopar eka(n)kaar niraalam su(n)n samaadh lagaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Above them is the Immaculate Lord, the One Universal Creator; they are lovingly absorbed in the profound, primal state of Samaadhi. ||3||
There are nine gates to the body-village;
the Creator Lord fashioned them for each and every person.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: dasavai purakh ateet niraalaa aape alakh lakhaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: Within the Tenth Gate, dwells the Primal Lord, detached and unequalled. The unknowable reveals Himself. ||4||
The Primal Lord cannot be held to account; True is His Celestial Court.
The Hukam of His Command is in effect; True is His Insignia.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak khoj lahahu ghar apanaa har aatam raam naam paaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, search and examine your own home, and you shall find the Supreme Soul, and the Name of the Lord. ||5||
